paper_title: Graph Clustering Problems Under the Lens of Parameterized Local Search
classifications: Theory of computation → Graph algorithms analysis
Theory of computation → Parameterized complexity and exact algorithms
statement: We analyzed the parameterized complexity for LS-Cluster Editing and LS-Cluster Deletion, leaving some open questions for future work: First, what is the complexity of LS-Cluster Deletion with respect to the combined parameter number |C| of clusters and k? Second, can we show lower bounds for the permissive variant of LS-Cluster Editing? Finally, can some of the algorithmic ideas of our work be used to improve the local-search based heuristics for Cluster Deletion or Cluster Editing?
